data.name: Faatina
data.gender_notes: Faatina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faatina is an Arabic name for girls, which means 'successful'. It is derived from the root 'f-t-n' which is used in many places in the Quran, and it implies achieving one's goals, being successful and victorious. The name Faatina carries the meaning “Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Faatina usually hope their child will grow to embody successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who seeks spiritual guidance and is successful in her endeavors.
data.etymology: Faatina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faatina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Faatina holds a significant cultural impact as it highlights the importance of hard work, determination, and striving towards achieving one's goals. In many Muslim societies, a child's name is seen as an essential part of their identity and can shape their outlook on life. By being given the name Faatina, girls are encouraged from a young age to work hard, overcome challenges, and strive for success in all aspects of their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Faatina holds great significance as it reminds us that success and victory in life do not come easily, but rather through steadfastness, perseverance, and reliance on Allah. In Surah Al-Anfaal, Allah (SWT) says, "And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant [that He made] with Prophet Adam and his offspring" [Quran 8:28]. By embracing the meaning of the name Faatina, we can deepen our commitment to living up to this covenant and utilizing the blessings and talents given to us by Allah (SWT) to achieve personal and collective success. Additionally, the name serves as a constant reminder to remain steadfast in our faith, as success in the hereafter is the ultimate goal.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Faatina: Possessor of wealth or abundant provider from Allah. A reminder of the blessings and trust bestowed upon us by Allah, to be utilized wisely and for the betterment of the community.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Faatina bint As-Sa'd ibn Mu'adh was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Faatina carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Faatina was a noblewoman from the tribe of Quraish. She was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in several Hadiths.
